title: Loans
intro: Compare home, personal, car, education, gold, property, two-wheeler and business loans from major Indian lenders: the rate you actually get depends on your credit score, income and the rate type, so look beyond the lowest advertised rate.
newsQuery: loan interest rates India RBI repo

rbiRepo.note: RBI policy repo rate; raised 25 bps from 5.25% to 5.50% at the 7 Oct 2026 MPC meeting (stance changed to calibrated tightening). Repo-linked loan rates are rising accordingly.

sources: Lender interest-rate and charges pages (checked Oct 2026)
BankBazaar / Paisabazaar rate tables citing lenders (Oct 2026)
Bank RLLR revisions after the repo hike (Bank of Baroda BRLLR 8.15% w.e.f. 8 Oct 2026)

params.label: Lowest interest rate
params.tip: Lowest advertised rate p.a., for the best credit profiles (Oct 2026).

params.label: Highest interest rate
params.tip: Top of the advertised range p.a. (Oct 2026).

params.label: Processing fee
params.tip: As published by the lender, Oct 2026. GST extra.

params.label: Max processing fee
params.tip: Highest % fee charged; blank if flat or not disclosed (Oct 2026).

params.label: Prepayment / foreclosure
params.tip: RBI bars these charges on floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business use.

params.label: Rate type
params.tip: Repo-linked rates move soon after RBI changes; MCLR lags; fixed stays put.

params.label: Min credit score
params.tip: Score commonly needed for approval; best rates usually need 750+ (Oct 2026).
